newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: First Pacific unit to manage Bonifacio.
newsitem.headline: First Pacific unit to manage Bonifacio.

text.p: Hong Kong-based First Pacific Davies, a unit of First Pacific Co Ltd, said it was forming a joint venture to manage the emerging Fort Bonifacio district in Manila.

The new company, Bonifacio Estate Services Corp, will be 80 percent jointly owned by First Pacific and Fort Bonifacio Development Corp (FBDC). The other 20 percent will be owned by the state-owned Bases Conversion Development Authority.
The joint venture company will provide property services and maintenance support for the new district, First Pacific said in a statement.
The 214-hectare district is expected to host 8.6 million square metres of gross floor area of high-rise offices, shopping malls, hotels, and residential condominiums.
The company is initially capitalised at 26 million pesos, FBDC external affairs officer May Dizon said.
At present, FBDC, the master developer of the area, is developing 45 hectares in preparation for building construction.
FBDC is majority owned by a consortium of local companies led by conglomerate Metro Pacific Corp, which is a subsidiary of First Pacific.
